notes.title: 🎉 Happy Birthday Kamaeru… and a New Adventure Begins! 🐸🐐
notes.notes:
[p]Hi friends! 💚[/p][p]Can you believe it? [i]Kamaeru: A Frog Refuge[/i] turned [b]ONE YEAR OLD[/b] last Sunday! 🥳[/p][p]
We’re so grateful for the love you’ve shown our cozy little frog world — your frog pictures, sweet messages, and support have meant everything to us. Thank you for hopping along with us! 🐸💚[/p][p][/p][p]But wait... there's more! We're thrilled to announce our [b]new game[/b]: [i]Heidi's Legacy[/i]! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeBMc6UMFtJGKzSJ3Wn7aBww_e9ckLTevyDP1_IQBbtb8Eeg2HDe7ZotWTLvgQxrN2QV4imCg58Hmyh8vtPkrxLFK5pJKTwEbxHFI_nkKJpelQCZ6xN5trUzKH24kC5yX_9tTUo?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]
Announced during [i]Wholesome Direct[/i], it’s a peaceful narrative sim set in the mountains, where you’ll care for goats, craft handmade goods, and help a village come back to life. Inspired by the spirit of the [i]Heidi[/i] novels, it’s a heartfelt story about nature, healing, and community. We think you’ll love it.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [url="https://s.team/a/3589430?utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=launch" style="button"]Visit Heidi’s Legacy page![/url][i] [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for being part of our cozy little world. Here’s to frogs, goats, and all other cute animals![/p][p]
With love,
Humble Reeds Team 💫[/p]

notes.title: Spooky Halloween update - and more! 🎃🐸
notes.notes:
Are you ready for… Froggo-ween? We sure are!

This update includes 2 new spooky pieces of furniture to decorate your frog refuge - perfect for adding a seasonal twist.

To unlock these, participate in a mini in-game pumpkin collecting event, where you’ll gather pumpkins all around your refuge and wetlands, then redeem them for the exclusive furniture!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225737/988f8a46b2fd66c834246c3bf0d6949660a2063f.jpg[/img]

We’re also thrilled to announce that Kamaeru is now available in Korean! Players can now enjoy the game in another language, expanding our frog-loving community even more 🐸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225737/ddf41e58c7c1228bee4825207e30a724ccb0e4a2.jpg[/img]

And for even more customization, we’ve heard your feedback about frogs hopping away too soon - that’s why we are introducing the Frog Timer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225737/dfa8c10029795a6ae1cd04b1ceeb39050848bd0f.jpg[/img]

This feature in the options panel will let you decide how long you want your frogs to stay in the furniture before jumping away. Perfect for ultimate coziness!

Last but not least, to raise even more awareness about Cleo’s and Axel’s mission, we’ve added an information panel on how wetlands capture carbon, offering insights into the important environmental role these ecosystems play.

Don't miss out —hop back into Kamaeru today and join the Halloween fun! 🎉

notes.title: Development Update #1: A New Biome
notes.notes:
[h1]Kamaeru: A Frog Refuge 
Development Update #1: A New Biome[/h1]

Hey froggy friends,

We’ve been overwhelmed by the response to Kamaeru since we launched the Steam page during the Wholesome Direct in June! It’s so exciting for us to see people as excited about frog collecting and wetlands restoring as we are. 🐸

We’ve been steadily working on the game since the announcement and wanted to share some teasers of what’s to come! 

The game is broken up into 3 separate biomes - you’ve so far only seen images and video from the first “European” biome. The past few months, we’ve been designing and implementing biome 2 in the game and we’re happy to announce-

[h2]Biome 2: Australia[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225737/18fe3d1539340e289a0b24e53a46e6d6c5111776.png[/img]

Once you’ve built up enough reputation in Biome 1, you’ll be able to open a new frog refuge in a billabong in Australia, where you’ll meet new friends and frogs and play new minigames!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225737/830bc959217eacdfcd3d4383d0c3f8043236d48f.gif[/img]

We don’t want to show off too much just yet, but if you’re interested in seeing more, keep an eye out in the next few weeks. We’ll be kicking off a beta playtest soon to get more player feedback on the game.

We can't wait to share more updates with you in the near future!

- Humble Reeds

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Kamaeru_game]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/kamaeru_game/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/kamaerufroggame/]Facebook[/url] for more updates!
